evaluators.title: Evaluation Logic
evaluators.description: Implements different evaluation strategies, such as numeric and string-based comparisons, to score agent performance.

evaluation_logic.title: Evaluation Logic
evaluation_logic.description: Provides core evaluation mechanisms for numerical and string-based comparisons against expected values.

evaluator_components.title: Core Evaluator Components
evaluator_components.description: Contains the fundamental classes for evaluating agent responses, including numeric and string-based comparisons.

success_rate_calculation.title: Success Rate Calculation
success_rate_calculation.description: Script for calculating and breaking down success rates based on various criteria like task achievability, website, and task type.

execution_and_testing.title: Execution and Testing
execution_and_testing.description: Manages the execution of agent tests and demonstrations, including environment setup, action processing, and result handling.

test_execution.title: Test and Demo Execution
test_execution.description: Manages the execution flow for both general tests and interactive demos, including agent interaction, action processing, and scoring.

test_runners.title: Test Case Runners
test_runners.description: Manages the execution of test cases for both standard evaluations and interactive demonstrations, orchestrating agent actions within the environment.

action_scoring.title: Action Scoring and Search
action_scoring.description: Provides functionality for taking and evaluating agent actions, especially within a search-based agent paradigm to determine optimal action sequences.

setup_and_initialization.title: Setup and Initialization
setup_and_initialization.description: Handles the initial setup of the environment and result directories for test and demo runs.

preparation_routines.title: Preparation Routines
preparation_routines.description: Handles the initial setup processes for both regular and demo runs, including result directory creation and prompt conversion.

evaluation_helpers.title: Evaluation Helper Functions
evaluation_helpers.description: Contains utility functions to assist in the evaluation process by fetching specific data from various platforms like Reddit and Shopping.

reddit_helpers.title: Reddit Helper Functions
reddit_helpers.description: Provides utility functions for interacting with Reddit content, such as fetching comment details.

reddit_comment_data_extraction.title: Reddit Comment Data Extraction
reddit_comment_data_extraction.description: Provides helper functions for extracting content and parent comment usernames from Reddit comments.

shopping_helpers.title: Shopping Helper Functions
shopping_helpers.description: Offers a suite of helper functions to interact with the shopping platform, including order details and product reviews.

shopping_order_helpers.title: Shopping Order Helpers
shopping_order_helpers.description: Offers utility functions to fetch order-related information, such as the latest order URL, product names, quantities, and options within an order.

shopping_review_helpers.title: Shopping Review Helpers
shopping_review_helpers.description: Provides functions to retrieve product review details and product page URLs from the shopping website.

general_utilities.title: General Utilities
general_utilities.description: Contains general utility functions useful across different evaluation scenarios.

llm_integrations.title: LLM Integrations
llm_integrations.description: Provides asynchronous utilities for interacting with various Large Language Model providers, specifically OpenAI's completion and chat APIs.

openai_completion_api.title: OpenAI Completion API
openai_completion_api.description: Handles asynchronous text generation using the OpenAI Completion API.

openai_chat_api.title: OpenAI Chat API
openai_chat_api.description: Manages asynchronous chat-based text generation via the OpenAI Chat Completion API.

prompt_construction.title: Prompt Construction
prompt_construction.description: Provides classes for constructing prompts for language models, supporting different strategies like multimodal CoT and direct prompting.

multimodal_cot_constructor.title: Multimodal CoT Constructor
multimodal_cot_constructor.description: Constructs prompts for multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning, incorporating images and text.

direct_prompt_constructor.title: Direct Prompt Constructor
direct_prompt_constructor.description: Generates direct prompts for language models without explicit Chain-of-Thought, primarily text-based.
